summary: Live main still publishes an XRP score of 44 with confidence 0.0 and explicit provider failures; its summary retains a positive/mixed narrative. The merge queue remains mutation-capable on main. Two fresh-main draft proposals were prepared: PR #1304 makes the merge queue read-only, and PR #1305 makes summaries fail closed on invalid/unavailable signals. Both proposals passed exact-head core CI and fail-closed gates; neither is merged. No market features or forecast were admitted.

findings.claim: Main XRP signal is invalid for forecast issuance
findings.note: Score 44, confidence 0.0, news score 88 from 11 entries, missing GitHub model credentials and Groq HTTP 429.

findings.claim: Summary remains directionally positive despite invalid confidence
findings.note: Signal and summary timestamps match at 2026-10-29T10:23:01Z; the defect is that the narrative treats bullish labels as meaningful despite unavailable sentiment and zero confidence.

findings.claim: Merge queue on main remains mutation-capable
findings.note: Write permissions, mode=all, non-dry-run default, unlimited max_prs=0, branch update, comment, merge and delete paths remain in main.
Fresh-main draft; exact-head core CI passed after correcting an initial malformed shell continuation; fail-closed gate passed. No merge.
Fresh-main draft; exact-head core CI and fail-closed gate passed. No merge.

findings.claim: Initial PR #1304 CI failure was corrected and preserved
findings.note: The test entry was initially emitted with a malformed shell continuation; corrected to one trailing backslash and reverified on exact head.

competing_hypotheses.statement: The high bullish headline score may be a topic/sentiment classification artifact because several entries are XRPL consensus or network-protocol research papers rather than independent market-moving disclosures.
disconfirming_evidence: Technical protocol research can eventually affect network utility or investor expectations; its relevance cannot be dismissed categorically.
tests_needed: Label technical papers separately from issuer, regulatory, exchange, flow and market-moving news; compare each class against pre-registered fixed-horizon XRP returns and volatility with leakage-safe walk-forward evaluation.

competing_hypotheses.statement: When provider failure is explicit and confidence is zero, any directional summary is unsupported and should be suppressed regardless of headline polarity.
disconfirming_evidence: A separately validated deterministic rule could produce a forecast without the unavailable provider, but no such rule or calibration evidence is established here.
tests_needed: Merge only after review; then verify main output and test fixed-horizon calibration, baselines and outcome recording before issuing any forecast.
